title: medicago tribuloides var. loneiaculeata
intro: Medicago tribuloides var. loneiaculeata, commonly known as the Tribulus, is a plant species in the legume family. It is a perennial herb with several health benefits, including potential effects on blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and sexual health. The therapeutic actions of Tribulus include its ability to stimulate testosterone production, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tribulus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
